svg.title: European final-energy mix: OMNIA-ENGAGE and GCAM

cc:Work.dc:title: European final-energy mix: OMNIA-ENGAGE and GCAM
cc:Work.dc:description: European final energy in a 2 × 3 layout with NDC above NDC+LTT and cement, steel and aluminium columns. Solid OMNIA-ENGAGE bars are paired with hatched GCAM bars in each category. Colours identify electricity, gases, hydrogen, liquids, solids and unallocated energy. Exact carrier parents enter each stack once. GCAM's reported sector total is retained; Unallocated is this total minus the sum of its supplied carrier parents (nonzero for aluminium). Missing fuel variables are not assigned to a carrier or silently imputed as zero. OMNIA totals sum the documented carrier parents. Historical references use 2019 (OMNIA) and 2021 (GCAM), with no interpolation. Future bars compare no, medium and high EU-only CE in 2050. Each future percentage uses the same model, pathway and year's no-CE final energy. Sector scales match across pathways and models. OMNIA totals sum EUE, EUM and EUW; GCAM selects its supplied EU-27 aggregate once, without adding country rows. These aggregates are checked against available-country sums. OMNIA regional boundaries include some small non-EU territories; membership is exported explicitly, so the two boundaries are not assumed identical. Source scenario names are retained: OMNIA baseline_* and GCAM LTT_* are displayed as NDC+LTT; ndc_* and NDC_* are displayed as NDC. Matching labels do not establish identical policy assumptions. OMNIA missing activity = zero (provisional); GCAM missing values remain gaps. Exact source variables, units, region memberships, conversion factors and calculation references accompany the source CSVs.
